definitions.explanation: The state of never aging and never dying. A concept found in mythology, religion, and fiction. The four-character compound literally means "not aging, not dying."

examples.japanese: {不老不死|ふろうふし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: To seek an elixir of immortality.

examples.japanese: {不老不死|ふろうふし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人類|じんるい}→人類：01578_jinrui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{永遠|えいえん}→永遠：01873_eien⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧だ。
examples.english: Eternal youth and immortality is humanity's eternal dream.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皇帝|こうてい}→皇帝：15856_koutei⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不老不死|ふろうふし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{試|ため}した→試す：02130_tamesu⟧。
examples.english: Ancient emperors tried various methods to obtain eternal youth and immortality.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) formed from {不老|ふろう} (not aging) + ⟦{不死|ふし}→不死：11711_fushi⟧ (not dying). Can also be used as a no-adjective: {不老不死|ふろうふし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧ (an immortal body).

CULTURAL NOTE:
The quest for {不老不死|ふろうふし} is a major theme in East Asian mythology. The legend of {徐福|じょふく}, sent by the Chinese emperor {秦|しん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{始皇帝|しこうてい} to find the elixir of immortality, is said to have brought him to Japan. The concept also appears frequently in anime, manga, and fantasy fiction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不老不死|ふろうふし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧: elixir of immortality
- {不老不死|ふろうふし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧: immortal body
- {不老不死|ふろうふし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to seek immortality
